title: Data Engineer
location: Kota Adm. Jakarta Selatan, DKI Jakarta
description_text:
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure that powers our analytics, machine learning, and operational systems. You will work closely with software engineers, and business stakeholders to turn raw, complex data into reliable, production-ready pipelines and datasets. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in data quality, reliability, and engineering excellence.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities :

Pipeline Design & Data Ingestion
• Design and build robust ETL/ELT pipelines for both batch and real-time processing, ensuring high throughput and fault tolerance.
• Ingest and process high-frequency data from diverse sources including REST/GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, IoT/sensor streams, and event queues.
• Transform raw, messy, and heterogeneous data into clean, validated, and production-ready datasets for downstream consumers.
• Architect and maintain data lake and data warehouse structures, including partitioning strategies, schema evolution, and data versioning.
• Evaluate, select, and integrate appropriate data tools and frameworks based on project requirements and scale.
ML & Analytics Support
• Support and deploy machine learning-ready pipelines, including feature engineering, data preprocessing, and preparation of model inputs and training datasets.
• Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML workflows, ensuring reproducibility and scalability of pipelines.
• Build and maintain feature stores and data marts that support analytical dashboards, reporting, and model serving.
• Develop and maintain data catalogues and metadata management systems to improve data discoverability and lineage.

Data Quality & Reliability
• Implement comprehensive data quality checks, validation frameworks, and alerting mechanisms across all pipelines.
• Monitor pipeline health, throughput, and latency; proactively diagnose and resolve data issues before they impact downstream systems.
• Design for scalability and reliability in production, applying best practices for idempotency, retry logic, and graceful failure handling.
• Conduct root cause analysis on data incidents and implement corrective and preventive measures.
Infrastructure & Orchestration
• Deploy and manage pipeline orchestration using tools such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
• Work with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) to provision and manage data infrastructure including storage, compute, and streaming services.
• Implement CI/CD practices for data pipelines, including automated testing, version control, and deployment pipelines.
• Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to containerize and deploy data workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.

Kualifikasi:
Required Experience :
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related discipline.
• 3–5 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines in production environments.
• Proven track record working with imperfect, noisy, and real-world data at scale.
• Experience with time-series or IoT data ingestion and processing is highly valued.
• Experience in a fintech, banking, SaaS, or high-availability production environment is strongly preferred.
• Exposure to agile development practices and cross-functional team collaboration.

Required Skills :
Core Engineering
• Strong proficiency in Python for data engineering tasks including data manipulation, pipeline scripting, and automation.
• Advanced SQL skills: query optimization, window functions, CTEs, indexing strategies, and working with large datasets.
• Solid understanding of data modelling concepts including star/snowflake schemas, dimensional modelling, and normalization.
• Experience with data serialization formats: JSON, Avro, Parquet, ORC, and Protobuf.

Pipeline & Streaming Tools
• Proven experience with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster for scheduling and dependency management.
• Exposure to streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, or AWS Kinesis for real-time data processing.
• Familiarity with ETL/ELT frameworks such as dbt, Spark, or Beam.
• Experience with change data capture (CDC) patterns and tools (e.g., Debezium) is an advantage.

Cloud & Infrastructure
• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: Amazon Web Services (S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda), Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub), or Microsoft Azure (Data Factory, Synapse, Event Hubs).
• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
• Working knowledge of containerization with Docker; experience with Kubernetes is a plus.
• Understanding of data lake architectures (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi).

Machine Learning Integration
• Experience with machine learning workflows including feature engineering, data preprocessing pipelines, and integration with ML frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, or similar).
• Familiarity with MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar ML lifecycle management tools is an advantage.
• Ability to work closely with data scientists to translate model requirements into scalable, production-grade data pipelines.

Soft Skills :
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose complex data issues in distributed systems under pressure.
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to produce clear technical documentation and present findings to stakeholders.
• Collaborative and proactive team player with experience working across data science, engineering, and product functions.
• Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership over data quality and pipeline reliability.
• Comfortable working with ambiguity and rapidly changing requirements in a fast-paced environment.

Working Environment
• Join a young and dynamic team in an international, professional, English-speaking environment.
• Work with cutting-edge data technologies and modern cloud platforms.
• Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and product teams on high-impact, large-scale projects.
• Open culture where people are valued, trusted, and empowered to do great things.

description_text:

Kualifikasi:
Overview
We are looking for a Computer Vision Engineer who can assess the technical feasibility of offline (on-device / edge) image recognition solutions, build and deploy YOLO-based detection models end-to-end, and also work with cloud-based computer vision services such as AWS Rekognition. Prior hands-on experience taking an offline model from research to production deployment is highly valued.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct technical feasibility assessments for offline image recognition needs: architecture selection, dataset size, compute/hardware requirements (edge device, GPU/CPU), latency, and storage constraints before development begins.
Design, train, and optimize image recognition / object detection models based on YOLO that can run fully offline (on-device/edge, no dependency on internet/cloud connectivity).
Perform data preparation, annotation, augmentation, and model evaluation (precision, recall, mAP, etc.).
Optimize models for deployment (quantization, pruning, conversion to lightweight formats such as ONNX / TensorRT / TFLite) so they run efficiently on target devices.
Handle end-to-end deployment of computer vision models to production/edge devices, including post-deployment monitoring and maintenance.
Explore and implement cloud-based computer vision / image recognition solutions (e.g., AWS Rekognition, Azure Computer Vision, Google Vision AI) as alternatives or complements to offline solutions.
Provide trade-off recommendations between offline (custom model) and cloud-based (managed service) solutions based on business needs, cost, data privacy, and infrastructure conditions.
Collaborate with product/engineering teams to integrate CV solutions into broader systems.
Document research processes, experiments, and evaluation results in a structured way

Qualifications
Hands-on experience building computer vision / image recognition models using YOLO (or similar detection architectures).
Proven, real experience building offline models — from research and training through to production/edge deployment (not just notebook-level experiments).
Familiarity with cloud-based CV services such as AWS Rekognition (or equivalent), able to compare use cases against custom/offline solutions.
Understanding of basic MLOps: model versioning, performance monitoring, retraining pipelines.
Familiar with tools/frameworks: Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, Docker.
Able to independently perform technical assessments (feasibility, effort, and risk) before project execution.
Nice to have: experience with edge devices (Jetson, Raspberry Pi, etc.) or mobile deployment (TFLite/CoreML).

Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
Minimum 2-5 years of hands-on experience in computer vision / machine learning.
Demonstrated portfolio or GitHub of past computer vision / object detection projects, ideally including at least one model taken to production or edge deployment.
Solid understanding of mathematics relevant to computer vision (linear algebra, probability, optimization).
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to independently judge project feasibility, effort, and risk.
Good communication skills, able to explain technical trade-offs (offline vs. cloud-based) to non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams.
Willing to work on-site/hybrid as needed for hardware testing and edge-device deployment (adjust based on company policy).

title: Data Analyst
location: Kota Adm. Jakarta Barat, DKI Jakarta
description_text:
About This Position

We are looking for a Data Analyst to support the Demand Planning team in improving demand forecast accuracy and reliability. You will analyze sales and demand patterns, develop forecasting logic, and build automated tools and monitoring to support inventory and fulfillment decisions, ensuring customer demand is met just-in-time.

If you enjoy turning data into practical forecasting solutions and working cross-functionally to improve product availability, we would love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities

- Demand Forecasting & Business Analysis

- Analyze demand patterns across SKU, hub, category, time period, campaign, price changes, and seasonal/festive events.

- Develop, evaluate, and improve demand forecasting logic, including baseline normalization, seasonality, festive events

- Monitor and analyze forecast-performance metrics

- Identify and investigate sales and demand anomalies, including unusual spikes or drops caused by festive events, trends, pricing changes, or operational disruption.

- Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for Demand Planners and Supply Chain stakeholders.

- Forecasting Logic, Automation & Data Products

- Translate Demand Planning business requirements into scalable data solutions, including datasets, forecasting logic, dashboards, alerts, and automated workflows.

- Build and maintain data models and pipelines supporting demand forecasting processes, including data preparation, normalization, imputation, reporting, and configuration management.

- Automate manual forecasting and monitoring processes using SQL, Python, BigQuery, workflow orchestration/DAGs, and integrations with Google Sheets or reporting tools.

- Develop alerts and trackers to enable timely responses to changes in demand, pricing, anomalies, campaign performance, and availability risk.

- Maintain clear documentation for technical logic, data lineage, source tables, configurations, business rules, and operational runbooks.

- Production Pipeline Ownership & Reliability

- Ensure the reliability and timeliness of daily forecasting pipelines and report-refresh processes.

- Conduct troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and remediation for data-quality issues, pipeline failures, reporting discrepancies, and forecast anomalies.

- Perform manual runs or backfills when required, ensuring workflow sequence and dependencies are executed correctly.

- Work with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to improve the robustness, scalability, and maintainability of forecasting systems.

Kualifikasi:
Must Have

- Minimum 1–3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Analytics Engineer, Supply Chain Analyst, or in a similar role.

- Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets, preferably in BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse.

- Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation, and/or pipeline development.

- Understanding of demand forecasting concepts and evaluation metrics, including baseline, seasonality, outliers, trends, and forecast accuracy metrics.

- Experience building dashboards, automated reports, data pipelines, monitoring tools, or alerts.

- Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and data-validation skills.

- Ability to communicate technical analysis and insights clearly to non-technical business stakeholders.

- High ownership, strong attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple dependencies.

Preferred Qualifications

- Having backgrounds in e-commerce, retail, quick commerce, FMCG, or supply chain related fields.

- Familiar with Airflow/Composer, Git, Google Data Studio, Apache Superset, Google Cloud Platform, or similar tools.

- Exposure to machine-learning forecasting workflows or collaboration with Data Science teams.

- Experience operating and maintaining production data pipelines, including incident handling and backfill processes.

title: Full Stack Developer
description_text:
Full Stack Developer

Kualifikasi:
## 📌 Lowongan: Fullstack Engineer (ERP System)

### 🧩 Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Kami mencari Fullstack Engineer yang akan terlibat langsung dalam pengembangan dan pengelolaan sistem ERP internal perusahaan & Customer Order.

Anda akan bekerja pada sistem yang sudah berjalan dan terus dikembangkan, dengan fokus pada scalability, maintainability, dan efisiensi operasional.
Siap melakukan extends development dari Sistem Berbasis B2B ke B2C

### ⚙️ Tanggung Jawab

- Mengembangkan dan memelihara fitur ERP berbasis web (backend & frontend)
- Mendesain dan mengimplementasikan arsitektur modular (feature-based / service-based)
- Mengoptimasi performa query dan sistem (khususnya pada data transaksi besar)
- Mengintegrasikan sistem dengan layanan eksternal (API, payment, dll)
- Membuat sistem yang robust untuk workflow approval dan business logic kompleks
- Berkolaborasi dengan tim untuk improve usability dan reliability sistem
- Melakukan debugging dan troubleshooting di production environment

### 🛠️ Kualifikasi Teknis (WAJIB)

- Pengalaman kuat dengan:
- PHP (Laravel / Lainnya)
- React (SPA / modular frontend)
- Flutter ( Modular Mobile )
- MariaDB / MySQL (advanced query, indexing, optimization)
- Docker Container
- Memahami konsep:
- REST API & API design best practices
- Authentication & authorization ( RBAC / permission system )
- Queue / background job processing
- Git workflow ( branching, PR, code review )
- Terbiasa bekerja di environment Linux

### ➕ Nilai Tambah (Tidak Wajib, Tapi Dicari)

- Pengalaman dengan Golang/Python untuk service/backend tambahan
- Pengalaman DevOps:
- Docker
- CI/CD pipeline
- Monitoring (Prometheus, Loki, dll)
- Mampu melakukan integrasi dengan services berbasis AI Model
- Agentic / Vibe Coder
- Pernah mengerjakan sistem ERP / accounting / HRIS
- Memahami kompleksitas business process (approval, audit trail, dll)

### 🧠 Kualifikasi Non-Teknis

- Mampu berpikir sistematis dan memahami alur bisnis, bukan cuma coding
- Tidak hanya “menunggu task”, tapi bisa mengidentifikasi problem sendiri
- Berani challenge requirement yang tidak masuk akal
- Bisa bekerja dengan struktur kode yang sudah ada (bukan rewrite semua dari nol)

### 🚫 Kandidat yang Tidak Cocok

- Hanya pernah membuat aplikasi CRUD sederhana
- Tidak paham transaksi database (ACID, race condition, dll)
- Tidak terbiasa debugging masalah real di production
- Tidak nyaman dengan sistem yang kompleks dan berkembang

### 🎯 Goal Posisi Ini
Membangun dan mengembangkan ERP yang stabil, scalable, dan bisa mendukung operasional bisnis secara penuh tanpa bottleneck teknis.

title: Full Stack Developer
location: Kota Adm. Jakarta Barat, DKI Jakarta
description_text:
Full Stack Developer

Kualifikasi:
Jobdesk & Responsibilities
Mengembangkan dan maintenance aplikasi mobile WillFitness untuk Android & iOS menggunakan Flutter.
Membuat fitur baru sesuai kebutuhan bisnis dan operasional perusahaan.
Mengintegrasikan aplikasi dengan API, database, payment gateway, dan third-party services.
Mengembangkan fitur seperti membership, check-in, QR code, attendance, profile member, transaksi, notification, dan fitur operasional lainnya.
Memastikan aplikasi memiliki performa yang baik, responsif, aman, dan mudah digunakan.
Melakukan debugging, testing, dan perbaikan bug pada aplikasi.
Melakukan integrasi dan maintenance backend/API jika diperlukan.
Berkoordinasi dengan UI/UX Designer, Backend Developer, dan tim terkait dalam pengembangan fitur.
Melakukan deployment dan update aplikasi ke Google Play Store & Apple App Store.
Melakukan monitoring aplikasi dan menangani issue setelah aplikasi digunakan.
Membuat dokumentasi teknis dan menjaga kualitas serta struktur kode.
Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi mobile dan memberikan improvement terhadap aplikasi.
Requirements
Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Mobile App Developer / Flutter Developer.
Menguasai Flutter & Dart.
Memahami REST API, JSON, authentication, dan database.
Memahami Git/GitHub.
Memahami integrasi API pihak ketiga.
Memahami Firebase/Push Notification menjadi nilai tambah.
Memahami deployment ke Play Store & App Store menjadi nilai tambah.
Memiliki kemampuan problem solving dan debugging yang baik.
Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun bersama tim.

title: Full Stack Developer (.Net - WFO Jakarta Utara)
location: Kota Adm. Jakarta Utara, DKI Jakarta
description_text:
Full Stack Developer (.Net - WFO Jakarta Utara)

Kualifikasi:
🚨 HIRING: Full Stack Developer (.NET) – Private Sector

We are looking for a Middle–Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET) to support the development and enhancement of enterprise-scale, high-transaction applications. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in .NET/.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, PostgreSQL, and Microservices Architecture, with solid troubleshooting and performance optimization skills.
📍 Location: Tanjung Priok, Jakarta Utara
🏢 Working Arrangement: WFO
📄 Contract: 6 Months, Extendable
💼 Level: Middle–Senior

🔹 Responsibilities
Develop and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using .NET/.NET Core.
Design and optimize data-access layers using Entity Framework Core.
Develop and optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexes, and database performance.
Design and implement Microservices Architecture and inter-service communication.
Troubleshoot application and database performance bottlenecks.
Ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable.
Collaborate with technical teams in a fast-paced development environment.

🔹 Requirements
5+ years of experience developing enterprise applications using .NET / .NET Core.
Strong knowledge of C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, OOP, Dependency Injection, Authentication & Authorization.
Strong hands-on experience with Entity Framework Core, LINQ, IQueryable, and query optimization.
Strong PostgreSQL experience, including complex SQL, indexing, transactions, database tuning, and EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
Experience troubleshooting N+1 queries, slow queries, and inefficient database access.
Experience with Microservices, DDD, distributed systems, and inter-service communication.
Familiar with Docker/Kubernetes, API Gateway, message queues, and distributed tracing.
Able to work independently and solve complex technical issues.

⭐ Nice to Have
Azure/AWS | CI/CD & DevOps | Redis | RabbitMQ | Kafka | Grafana | Prometheus | ELK | Application Insights

* Linux server basic
* Database server

title: Software Engineer
description_text:
About SMS Perkasa

We're an innovative steel and building materials distributor based in Surabaya, transforming how the industry operates through technology. While others in the steel trade rely on spreadsheets and phone calls, we build software that gives us — and our customers — a real edge. 🏗️

The Role

You won't just write code here. You'll steer AI agents that write code, then make sure it's actually good. We use AI coding tools daily — not as novelties, but as core parts of how we ship software. Your job is to define the problem clearly, direct AI to build the solution, review every line it produces, and own what goes to production. 🤖

If that sounds like managing a small engineering team rather than being a solo coder — you're getting the idea. 🎯

What You'll Do

- Break down business problems into clear specs and architectural prompts that guide AI agents toward correct solutions

- Direct AI coding tools to generate, test, and iterate on code across our systems — from internal platforms to customer-facing products

- Design system architecture — APIs, databases, integrations — and make decisions that hold up as we scale

- Own features end-to-end: from understanding the business need, through implementation, to production deployment

- Write tests that keep AI agents (and yourself) honest. Strong test coverage is how you move fast without breaking things

- Collaborate directly with our team to translate real operational challenges in the steel industry into working software

What We Offer

We're a young team that builds things that matter — tools that impact how steel and building materials move across Indonesia. You'll have real freedom to explore ideas and make your own decisions. No one here is going to micromanage you. 💡

Come with your bright ideas. Speak up. Challenge assumptions. That's how we work. 🗣️

title: Performance & Growth Marketing Manager
description_text:
Performance & Growth Marketing Manager

Kualifikasi:
Skyshi is looking for a Performance & Growth Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition and growth experiments end-to-end. This is a hands-on role for someone who can run performance campaigns with rigor and, in the same week, ship an unconventional growth play on Reddit or a niche community. You take a hypothesis (or just a hunch) and test it fast, without waiting for a full playbook.

What you'll do

Paid acquisition
Own and optimise all paid channels (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta, Reddit Ads, retargeting, review sites)
Build, launch, and iterate on campaigns end-to-end: setup, creative briefs, bidding, reporting
Allocate budget across channels based on CAC, pipeline contribution, and payback
Run structured A/B tests on creative, targeting, landing pages, and offers
Partner with design and content on ad creative, landing pages, and conversion flows
Report on the metrics that matter: pipeline, MQL to SQL, CAC, ROAS, payback
Growth hacking and organic experiments
Run organic growth plays where our buyers actually hang out: Reddit, LinkedIn, industry forums, construction communities, Slack/Discord groups
Identify and test new acquisition channels before competitors touch them
Set up experiment cycles with clear hypotheses, sample sizes, and kill criteria
Build lightweight automations and workflows to scale what works
Find creative wedges into the construction market that traditional B2B playbooks miss

Ways of working
Move fast: ship experiments weekly, kill losers quickly, double down on winners
Own the full loop: hypothesis, execution, measurement, decision
Bring numbers to every conversation, but stay creative on the input side
Manage your own priorities and deliver without hand-holding

What we're looking for
Proven experience running paid channels for a B2B SaaS company (this is a must, not a nice-to-have)
Track record of shipping growth experiments outside of paid, especially community-led plays like Reddit organic
Strong analytical instincts: you can build a funnel, size an opportunity, and read attribution honestly
Comfortable across the full paid stack (Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit) and modern attribution setups
Self-starter who spots an untested channel and just runs the experiment
Bias for speed on tests, and for polish on the things that scale

Tools
Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Reddit Ads
HubSpot (or similar) for lifecycle, attribution, and pipeline reporting
GA4, Mixpanel, or similar for funnel analytics
Ahrefs or similar for SEO and organic opportunity mapping
Zapier, n8n, or similar for lightweight growth automation
AI tools for ad copy, creative variants, and audience research

Nice to have
Experience marketing to construction, trades, or other non-tech industries
Product-led growth experience or work on self-serve funnels
Direct experience running a Reddit organic strategy at scale
Familiarity with ABM motions and outbound-adjacent growth tactics

description_text:
Digital Marketing Manager

Kualifikasi:
Role Overview:
Biteship is looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to lead and orchestrate our marketing function across acquisition, content, CRM, campaigns, and channel performance. You will translate business priorities into integrated marketing plans, coordinate internal and external resources, and ensure marketing initiatives contribute to sustainable growth and healthy customer acquisition economics.
This role combines strategic ownership with hands-on involvement across execution and performance measurement. You should be comfortable moving between campaign planning, content creation, agency coordination, data analysis, and optimization as needed.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop annual, quarterly, and monthly marketing priorities across search, content, social, paid acquisition, CRM, and campaigns.
Lead end-to-end marketing campaigns, from audience and messaging to channel mix, execution, KPI tracking, and post-campaign evaluation.
Develop and manage the monthly content and campaign calendar based on business priorities, customer insights, market trends, competitor activity, and search opportunities.
Translate marketing objectives into messaging, content themes, creative briefs, and channel-specific plans, while reviewing or creating key assets such as KV, copy, captions, landing pages, email, and blog content when needed.
Manage external marketing partners, including social media and performance marketing agencies, ensuring priorities, deliverables, budgets, and KPIs are aligned.
Work closely with the SEO Specialist to align search strategy, website content, editorial priorities, and campaign opportunities.
Own CRM and lifecycle marketing initiatives through Hubspot, including segmentation, nurturing, reactivation, automation, and lead handoff.
Own marketing performance measurement end to end, including data collection, reporting, analysis, and recommendations across CAC, CLTV, lead quality, conversion, customer acquisition, and channel performance.
Collaborate with Sales, Product, Operations, Engineering, and other stakeholders to support product launches, business initiatives, and customer-facing communications.
Support PR, media placement, thought leadership, and other external communications when relevant, while continuously identifying initiatives to scale, improve, deprioritize, or stop.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
3-5 years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, growth marketing, or a related field in B2B, SaaS, logistics, e-commerce, technology, or marketplace businesses.
Strong understanding of digital acquisition, content marketing, SEO, paid media, CRM, and marketing funnels.
Experience planning and managing integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
Experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, or similar analytics tools.
Understanding of SEO, GEO/AEO, and AI-driven search behavior.
Familiarity with CAC, CLTV, attribution, lead scoring, and lifecycle marketing.

- Develop and execute digital marketing strategies focused on generating qualified b2b leads and supporting the company’s sales pipeline.

MyRepublic (Sinarmas Group) lagi nyari pasukan baru! 🚀

WiFi Marketing Executive (Sales WiFi My Republic) itu intinya tugasnya nyari pelanggan baru buat pasang WiFi, tapi kalau dijelasin pakai bahasa gaul biar gampang dipahami:

> tidak takut dengan target, malah suka tantangan!

> Gaji Pokok (biar dapur ngebul)
> Insentif & Bonus (biar makin semangat ngejar target)
> Jenjang Karier (kesempatan buat naik level!)
> BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (Biar kerja tenang anti cemas)
Jangan khawatir, semua data kamu bakal aman banget di kita. 😊

📌 Ini lho yang bakal kamu kerjain sebagai Sales Squad MyRepublic (AE/DS/BA/Canvasser/BDR):
🎯 1. Jualan Cepat, Internet Ngebut!
* Intinya: Kerjaan kamu simpel banget: nawarin paket Wi-Fi MyRepublic yang super kenceng ke rumah-rumah, kantor, atau tempat-tempat keren lainnya.
* Analogi: Kamu kayak influencer atau hype man yang ngenalin orang-orang ke koneksi internet terbaik. Bikin mereka FOMO kalau belum pakai!
🗺️ 2. WFO Ala Road Trip
* Gak cuma di kantor: Kamu bakal sering keliling-keliling (Door to Door) di area penempatan kamu.
* Ajak Event: Kamu juga bisa nongkrong di event-event atau booth yang lagi ramai (Event to Event). Ini kesempatan buat ketemu banyak orang dan networking.
* Vibe-nya: Kerja fleksibel, gak monoton di meja. Get paid to walk around dan socialize!
📶 3. Produk yang Wajib Ada
* Apa yang kamu jual? Internet Wi-Fi—produk yang dicari semua orang (serius, siapa yang gak butuh Wi-Fi?).
* Saingan? Ya, ada. Kayak Indihome, dll. Tapi produk kita punya value unik yang bisa kamu banggain.
* Penting: Kamu jualan kebutuhan dasar era digital. Kamu bantu orang biar gak buffering saat mabar atau streaming!

🔥 Simpelnya gini:
“Kerjanya bukan cuma jualan, tapi jadi orang yang ngenalin dan ngebantu orang buat punya internet rumah yang kenceng dan cocok buat kebutuhan mereka.”

🔥 Ready buat jadi bagian dari tim yang bikin internet Indonesia makin ngebut? Good luck buat interview-nya!

digital marketing specialist

Kualifikasi:
Kami sedang mencari individu yang kreatif, berorientasi pada data, dan handal dalam periklanan digital untuk bergabung bersama tim kami sebagai Advertiser. Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman mengelola paid traffic, paham strategi pembuatan landing page dan order form, serta siap mendongkrak penjualan produk kami, mari bergabung dan berkembang bersama kami!

📌 Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Merancang, mengeksekusi, dan mengoptimalkan strategi kampanye iklan berbayar (khususnya di Meta Ads) untuk mencapai target penjualan dan return on ad spend (ROAS) yang optimal.
Membuat dan mengeksekusi materi konten iklan secara mandiri, mulai dari konsep visual, materi kreatif, hingga copywriting yang persuasif dan menjual.
Membuat dan mengelola landing page sertaorder form menggunakan platform berbasis web Scalevuntuk memaksimalkan tingkat konversi (conversion rate).
Melakukan pemantauan data, analisis performa harian, dan A/B testing untuk evaluasi kampanye iklan.
Memanfaatkan berbagai perangkat berbasis AI untuk mendukung riset pasar, efisiensi kerja, maupun pembuatan sudut pandang (angle) iklan yang segar.

Keahlian Konten: Mampu membuat copywriting yang kuat serta memproduksi konten iklan secara mandiri.
Adaptasi Teknologi: Mampu memanfaatkan kecerdasan buatan (AI tools) untuk mendukung efektivitas strategi iklan.
Nilai Tambah: Memiliki pengalaman beriklan di platform marketplace (seperti Shopee Ads atau TikTok Ads) akan menjadi nilai tambah yang besar.

description_text:
- Manage the performance of company-owned online stores and marketplace channels to achieve established sales and revenue targets.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with Marketplace Account / Relationship Managers to support channel growth and maximize commercial opportunities.

- Coordinate the implementation of company campaigns across all online sales channels according to approved timelines and campaign objectives.

- Ensure product catalogs, pricing, promotions, banners, product availability, and other online merchandising elements are accurate and consistently updated.

- Monitor the performance of each online sales channel and provide data-driven recommendations to improve sales, traffic, and profitability.

- Identify and develop joint business opportunities and promotional programs with marketplace partners to drive incremental sales.

- Monitor marketplace trends, competitor activities, pricing, platform programs, and consumer behavior to support online sales strategies.

- Coordinate with Marketing, Sales, Warehouse, Customer Service, Finance, and other relevant functions to ensure successful campaigns, smooth e-commerce operations, order fulfillment, and achievement of online sales targets.

- Oversee day-to-day e-commerce operations, including product catalog management, stock availability, customer shopping experience, order management, and overall channel quality.

- Optimize traffic, conversion rate (CRO), and sales performance through data analysis, campaign management, online merchandising, and KPI-based recommendations.

- Prepare regular online sales and channel performance reports, including key insights, issues, and improvement opportunities.

- Execute special projects, initiatives, and ad hoc assignments assigned by management to support departmental and company objectives.

Kualifikasi:
- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, E-Commerce, Management, or a related field.

- Minimum 2–4 years of experience in E-Commerce, Marketplace Management, Online Sales, Digital Commerce, or related functions.

- Hands-on experience managing marketplaces and/or company-owned online stores, preferably Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Lazada, or similar platforms.

- Proven experience in managing online sales targets, product catalogs, pricing, promotions, campaigns, and marketplace operations.

- Experience working directly with Marketplace Account / Relationship Managers and managing commercial partnerships.

- Strong understanding of e-commerce KPIs, including GMV, revenue, traffic, conversion rate, AOV, sell-through, and campaign performance.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate sales and channel data into actionable recommendations.

- Understanding of CRO, online merchandising, marketplace algorithms, and digital promotional mechanics.

- Strong coordination skills with Marketing, Sales, Warehouse, Customer Service, Finance, and other cross-functional teams.

- Proficient in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets; experience with e-commerce analytics and reporting tools is an advantage.

- Strong attention to detail, commercial awareness, and problem-solving skills.

- English proficiency is an advantage.

title: Social Media Specialist / Content Creator
description_text:
Social Media Specialist / Content Creator

Kualifikasi:
## Tentang Kami

Syakura Student Living merupakan hunian mahasiswa yang hadir dengan konsep modern, nyaman, dan terintegrasi di kawasan pendidikan. Untuk area Bogor, Syakura Student Living berfokus pada pengembangan hunian mahasiswa di sekitar IPB Dramaga sekaligus membangun ekosistem dan komunitas yang aktif.

Saat ini kami mencari **Content Creator / Social Media Specialist** yang kreatif, adaptif terhadap tren, memahami karakter audiens mahasiswa, serta mampu mengembangkan media sosial sebagai salah satu kanal utama untuk meningkatkan **brand awareness, engagement, leads, dan mendukung pemasaran properti Syakura Student Living Bogor.**

## Tanggung Jawab Utama

* Membuat ide, konsep, dan eksekusi konten kreatif untuk Instagram, TikTok, dan platform digital lainnya.
* Membuat konten dalam bentuk foto, video, Reels, TikTok, Story, serta konten informatif dan promotional.
* Menyusun dan mengelola content plan serta kalender konten mingguan dan bulanan.
* Melakukan riset tren, kompetitor, serta perilaku audiens mahasiswa dan pasar properti.
* Mengembangkan content pillar dan karakter komunikasi Syakura Student Living Bogor secara konsisten.
* Melakukan proses produksi konten secara end-to-end, mulai dari ide, script, shooting, editing hingga publikasi.
* Mendokumentasikan aktivitas penghuni, fasilitas, event, kawasan, progres properti, dan kegiatan marketing.
* Mengelola akun media sosial serta menjaga interaksi dengan audiens.
* Membuat copywriting dan caption yang menarik serta sesuai dengan tone of voice Syakura.
* Berkolaborasi dengan tim Marketing, Sales, Property Management, dan Creative dalam menjalankan campaign.
* Membantu pengembangan strategi KOL, influencer, mahasiswa, komunitas kampus, dan talent untuk kebutuhan konten.
* Membuat brief serta mengoordinasikan kebutuhan konten bersama talent/KOL.
* Mengikuti dan mengadaptasi tren media sosial yang relevan tanpa menghilangkan identitas brand.
* Menganalisis performa konten berdasarkan reach, views, engagement, follower growth, leads, dan conversion.
* Memberikan rekomendasi serta melakukan optimasi berdasarkan hasil performa konten.
* Membuat laporan performa media sosial secara berkala.

## Kualifikasi

* Pendidikan minimal minimal SMA/SMK sederajat, Marketing, Desain, Multimedia, atau bidang relevan.
* Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Content Creator / Social Media Specialist menjadi nilai tambah.
* Memahami Instagram, TikTok, Reels, dan perkembangan tren media sosial.
* Terbiasa membuat konten secara end-to-end.
* Mampu melakukan riset ide dan trend hunting.
* Mampu melakukan shooting foto/video menggunakan smartphone maupun kamera.
* Menguasai aplikasi editing seperti **CapCut, Canva**, atau software sejenis.
* Memiliki kemampuan storytelling dan copywriting yang baik.
* Memiliki visual sense yang kuat terkait komposisi, warna, angle, dan estetika konten.
* Memahami dasar algoritma media sosial, engagement, prime time, hook, retention, dan CTA.
* Familiar dengan Instagram Insights, TikTok Analytics, Meta Business Suite, atau tools analytics lainnya.
* Mampu bekerja dengan timeline dan target konten mingguan maupun bulanan.
* Kreatif, komunikatif, proaktif, dan memiliki inisiatif tinggi.
* Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun bersama tim.
* Siap bekerja dengan target performa seperti engagement, audience growth, leads, dan conversion.
* Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, serta memiliki komitmen terhadap perusahaan.

## Nilai Plus

* Pernah membuat konten untuk bidang **property, hospitality, kost, lifestyle, atau student living**.
* Memahami karakter mahasiswa IPB dan lingkungan kampus Dramaga.
* Memiliki portofolio konten TikTok/Reels dengan performa yang baik.
* Memiliki pengalaman bekerja sama dengan KOL, influencer, talent, atau komunitas kampus.
* Mampu menjadi talent atau host dalam konten.
* Mampu membuat konsep campaign yang berorientasi pada awareness sekaligus menghasilkan leads.
* Memahami basic digital marketing dan advertising menjadi nilai tambah.

title: Akuntan Pajak
location: Kota Adm. Jakarta Pusat, DKI Jakarta
description_text:
Akuntan Pajak

Kualifikasi:
PT Megannesons Mandayu Sejati adalah perusahaan distributor dan aplikator bahan bangunan yang terpercaya di Jakarta Pusat, DKI Jakarta. Kami menawarkan berbagai produk berkualitas seperti Conwood, WPC, Rooftop, Alderon, Fumira, dan lainnya yang digunakan dalam proyek konstruksi dan pembangunan. Kami sedang mencari seorang Akuntan Pajak yang kompeten dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami, karena kebutuhan akan pengelolaan keuangan dan pajak yang lebih efisien dan akurat semakin meningkat. Kami percaya bahwa dengan penambahan tenaga ahli ini, kami dapat meningkatkan kinerja operasional dan memastikan kepatuhan terhadap regulasi pajak yang berlaku.

Billing & Documentation Admin
Tugas & Tanggung Jawab Utama :
- Memeriksa keabsahan dan kelengkapan dokumen dasar penagihan sebelum invoice dicetak, seperti Purchase Order (PO) dari klien, Surat Jalan (SJ) yang sudah ditandatangani, Berita Acara Serah Terima (BAST), atau kontrak kerja.
- Berkoordinasi dengan tim Sales atau Gudang jika terdapat ketidaksesuaian antara jumlah barang/jasa yang dipesan dengan yang dikirim.
- Menginput data ke dalam sistem akuntansi untuk menerbitkan invoice, nota debit/kredit, atau kwitansi resmi.
- Berkoordinasi dengan Tim Pajak (Tax) untuk menerbitkan Faktur Pajak PPN (e-Faktur) yang harus dilampirkan bersama invoice.
- Mengirimkan dokumen penagihan kepada konsumen secara tepat waktu, baik melalui email (softcopy) maupun kurir (hardcopy).
- Mengarsipkan semua salinan invoice beserta dokumen pendukungnya secara rapi, sistematis, dan mudah dicari (baik dalam bentuk fisik maupun digital).
- Memantau dan memastikan bahwa dokumen penagihan yang dikirim telah diterima dan ditandatangani oleh bagian keuangan pihak konsumen (sebagai bukti dasar perhitungan jatuh tempo).
- Menyusun laporan harian atau mingguan mengenai jumlah invoice yang telah diterbitkan, dikirim, dan yang masih tertahan (pending).

Kualifikasi & Spesifikasi Kerja:
- Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Akuntansi, Manajemen, Administrasi Bisnis, atau bidang terkait.
- Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bagian Administrasi Penagihan, Billing, atau Finance Admin (lulusan baru dengan ketelitian tinggi dipersilakan).
- Keahlian Teknis (Hard Skills): Menguasai Microsoft Excel untuk pencatatan dan monitoring dokumen (rumus dasar, filter, dan tabel).
- Terbiasa mengoperasikan Coretax.
- Memahami kelengkapan dokumen legal komersial (tahu perbedaan PO, Surat Jalan, Invoice, dan Kwitansi).
- Keahlian Perilaku (Soft Skills) Sangat Teliti: Memiliki akurasi tinggi dalam memeriksa angka, nama perusahaan, alamat, dan deskripsi barang/jasa.
- Teratur & Rapi: Memiliki kemampuan manajemen arsip (filing system) yang baik.
- Proaktif: Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik ke tim internal (Sales/Logistik) untuk mengejar kelengkapan dokumen yang kurang.

title: Akuntan Keuangan
description_text:
Akuntan Keuangan

Kualifikasi:
Al Jazeerah Signature Restaurant & Lounge Bali adalah restoran dan lounge yang menghadirkan cita rasa autentik Timur Tengah dan Mediterania di Bali. Berlokasi di Sunset Road, Badung, restoran ini menawarkan pengalaman bersantap yang elegan dengan pilihan hidangan khas berkualitas tinggi, suasana yang nyaman, serta pelayanan profesional. Dengan kapasitas hingga 500 tamu dan fasilitas tiga lantai, Al Jazeerah Signature menjadi destinasi favorit untuk makan bersama keluarga, pertemuan bisnis, acara sosial, hingga perayaan spesial. Kami berkomitmen untuk memberikan pengalaman kuliner yang berkesan melalui kualitas makanan, keramahan layanan, dan atmosfer yang unik. Kini kami sedang mencari seseorang yang kompeten dan antusias untuk bergabung dalam tim kami sebagai Akuntan dan Admin Akunting, yang akan berkontribusi pada keberlanjutan operasional keuangan dan administrasi perusahaan.

Sebagai Akuntan dan Admin Akunting, Anda akan bertanggung jawab atas pengelolaan buku catatan keuangan, pemrosesan transaksi keuangan, pembuatan laporan keuangan, dan penyiapan dokumen pajak. Anda juga akan melakukan pengelolaan akun payable dan receivable, serta memastikan keakuratan data keuangan perusahaan. Selain itu, Anda akan membantu dalam pengelolaan administrasi keuangan, termasuk pencatatan transaksi harian, pelaporan keuangan bulanan, dan koordinasi dengan pihak terkait. Posisi ini membutuhkan ketelitian, kemampuan analitis, serta keahlian dalam menggunakan software akuntansi seperti MYOB, Zahir Software, dan Microsoft Excel untuk mendukung proses akuntansi yang efisien dan akurat.

Kami mencari kandidat yang memiliki gelar S1 dari jurusan terkait seperti Akuntansi atau Keuangan. Pengalaman minimal 1 hingga 3 tahun dalam bidang akuntansi, terutama dalam pengelolaan accounts payable, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, dan pajak, merupakan nilai tambah. Kandidat harus mahir dalam penggunaan Microsoft Excel, serta memiliki pemahaman tentang akuntansi keuangan, analisis keuangan, pajak penghasilan, dan sistem akuntansi seperti MYOB dan Zahir Software. Kami menyambut semua yang memiliki semangat belajar, tanggung jawab, dan kemampuan bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.

title: Akuntan Pajak
description_text:
Akuntan Pajak

Kualifikasi:
PT Plazza Pangestu Nusantara by Juragan Omah, sebagai Developer Perumahan Subsidi yang berdiri sejak Tahun 2020, memiliki total proyek seluas lebih dari 15 Ha, yang tersebar di Kota dan Kabupaten Malang. Perusahaan ini memiliki misi menciptakan kawasan perumahan yang nyaman, terintegrasi, terjamin secara fisik maupun legal namun dapat dijangkau oleh berbagai segmen masyarakat. Karena pertumbuhan bisnis yang pesat dan komitmen untuk memperkuat sistem keuangan dan pajak perusahaan, kami sedang mencari seseorang yang berkompeten dalam bidang akuntansi pajak untuk bergabung dengan tim kami.

Sebagai Akuntan Pajak, Anda akan bertanggung jawab atas pengelolaan dan penyusunan laporan pajak perusahaan sesuai ketentuan hukum yang berlaku. Anda juga akan melakukan analisis pajak, mengelola dokumen administrasi keuangan, serta bekerja sama dengan divisi lain dalam menyiapkan data yang diperlukan. Selain itu, Anda akan memastikan kepatuhan perusahaan terhadap regulasi pajak dan memberikan rekomendasi untuk efisiensi pengelolaan pajak. Dalam posisi ini, Anda akan menjadi bagian penting dalam menjaga kinerja keuangan perusahaan secara keseluruhan.

Kami mencari kandidat dengan gelar S1 dari jurusan Akuntansi atau bidang terkait. Pengalaman minimal 1 hingga 3 tahun dalam bidang akuntansi pajak akan menjadi nilai tambah. Kandidat harus memiliki kemampuan dalam penyusunan laporan pajak, penggunaan Microsoft Excel, pemahaman tentang akuntansi, akuntansi pajak, analisis kredit, serta administrasi kantor. Kami menyambut para profesional yang memiliki semangat belajar, tanggung jawab tinggi, dan kemampuan bekerja dalam tim.

Kami mencari seorang profesional di bidang akuntansi dan keuangan untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Cedar Home Store. Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk mengelola dan mengawasi laporan keuangan, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan perpajakan dan kepabeanan, serta menyusun dan melaporkan pajak bulanan.

Kualifikasi:
Lancar berbahasa Inggris lisan & tulisan, teliti, jujur, semangat & bertanggung jawab, SI Ekonomi, Keuangan/Akuntansi/Setara, usia maksimal 38 tahun, berpengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang industri furniture, mahir dengan kontrol keuangan, penetapan biaya, peraturan perpajakan, keuangan dan sistem akuntansi, memiliki sertifikat Brevet A dan B, memahami transaksi perbankan, mahir Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PPT, DLL), paham tentang pembukuan keuangan secara umum, mengetahui regulasi pelaporan perpajakan dan kepabeanan, menyiapkan dan mengawasi pembuatan laporan keuangan yang akurat dan tepat waktu.

description_text:
Kami mencari seorang Staff Keuangan yang bertanggung jawab untuk mencatat dan mengelola arus kas, mengelola dana operasional, menyusun laporan keuangan, melakukan rekonsiliasi data keuangan, mengelola kebutuhan keuangan, melakukan arsip seluruh bukti transaksi dan dokumen keuangan, serta melakukan koordinasi berkala dengan leader.

title: Accounting Supervisor
description_text:
Kami mencari seorang Accounting Supervisor yang berpengalaman untuk mengelola aktivitas akuntansi perusahaan. Bertanggung jawab mengawasi dan mengelola seluruh aktivitas akuntansi perusahaan, memastikan pencatatan transaksi sesuai standar akuntansi yang berlaku, menyusun laporan keuangan konsolidasi, melakukan kontrol dan rekonsiliasi, serta mengembangkan dan memastikan implementasi SOP keuangan.

Kualifikasi:
Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi/Keuangan, pengalaman minimal 3-5 tahun di bidang akuntansi, memiliki pengalaman sebagai supervisor/leader, menguasai laporan keuangan & perpajakan, teliti, detail, dan memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik, serta mampu bekerja dalam tim maupun individu.

title: Staf Akuntansi
description_text:
Staf Akuntansi

Kualifikasi:
Kami Dari Yuna Consulting mencari kandidat untuk Posisi Staf Akuntansi, Pajak dan Keuangan

Kualifikasi
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau bidang terkait.
2. Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang akuntansi dan keuangan
3. Memahami standar akuntansi dan peraturan perpajakan di Indonesia.
4. Mahir menggunakan software akuntansi (Accurate, Jurnal ID atau lainnya) dan Microsoft Excel.
5. Memiliki kemampuan analisa yang kuat, teliti, dan detail.
6. Jujur, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja dengan deadline.
7. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim
8. Bisa Menggunakan Aplikasi Coretax Pajak.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan:
1. Membuat dan mengelola laporan keuangan
2. Melakukan pencatatan transaksi keuangan
3. Membantu proses rekonsiliasi dan administrasi keuangan lainnya
4. Menginput Data ke Aplikasi Coretax

title: E-Commerce Specialist
description_text:

· Mengawasi dan mengarahkan operasional toko online perusahaan di berbagai platform e-commerce.
· Mengontrol dan memastikan semua listing produk.
· Memantau kinerja penjualan, traffic, dan konversi.
· Mengatur, mengawasi, dan mengevaluasi pelaksanaan kampanye promosi di platform e-commerce.
· Menyusun laporan performa toko online.

Kualifikasi:
Kualifikasi
· Pendidikan minimal S1
· Pengalaman min 1 tahun mengelola e-commerce (shopee, tokopedia, atau D2C)
· Terbiasa dengan target dan mempunyai growth mindset
· Mahir Google Ads, Meta Ads, dan mengelola CPAS.

description_text:

title: Marketing Executive
description_text:
Herba Indo Academy membuka kesempatan untuk bergabung dengan tim kami sebagai Marketing Executive dan Sales Promotion. Sebagai bagian dari tim pemasaran, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk meningkatkan kesadaran merek, mengembangkan strategi pemasaran, dan mencapai target penjualan.

Kualifikasi:
Pria/Wanita, 18-30 tahun, minimal SMA/SMK (D3/S1 diprioritaskan), komunikatif & percaya diri, siap kerja dengan target, berpengalaman jadi MLM (tidak wajib)

title: E-Commerce  Specialist
description_text:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan
· Mengawasi dan mengarahkan operasional toko online perusahaan di berbagai platform e-commerce.
· Mengontrol dan memastikan semua listing produk.
· Memantau kinerja penjualan, traffic, dan konversi.
· Mengatur, mengawasi, dan mengevaluasi pelaksanaan kampanye promosi di platform e-commerce.
· Menyusun laporan performa toko online.

Kualifikasi:
Kualifikasi
· Pendidikan minimal S1
· Pengalaman min 1 tahun mengelola e-commerce (shopee, tokopedia, atau D2C)
· Terbiasa dengan target dan mempunyai growth mindset
· Mahir Google Ads, Meta Ads, dan mengelola CPAS.

title: Finance / Accounting
description_text:
Venus Men’s Wellness Spa lagi cari talenta terbaik buat join tim Finance/Accounting! Kalau kamu punya minat di dunia keuangan, detail oriented, dan suka angka, sini gabung sama kami! Kamu akan bertanggung jawab atas pengelolaan keuangan, pembuatan laporan, dan memastikan semua transaksi tercatat dengan baik. Ini kesempatan buat berkembang dan jadi bagian dari tim yang seru!

Kualifikasi:
Buat kamu yang tertarik, berikut kualifikasinya:
- Minimal lulusan SMA/SMK
- Punya pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang Finance, Accounting, atau Cashier
- Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Office (Excel & Word) dan komputer
- Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik
- Teliti, disiplin, jujur, dan bisa menjaga kerahasiaan informasi keuangan

title: Akuntansi dan Keuangan
description_text:

title: Staff Accounting
description_text:
Kami mencari seorang Staff Accounting yang teliti dan memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang siklus keuangan untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Dayamitra Propertindo. title: Internal Auditor
description_text:
Posisi Internal Auditor bertanggung jawab untuk melakukan audit internal pada aspek keuangan dan operasional perusahaan. Tugas utamanya meliputi pemeriksaan dan analisis data AR, AP, serta purchasing, menyusun laporan hasil audit beserta rekomendasinya, melakukan tindak lanjut atas temuan audit, serta memastikan tindakan korektif telah dijalankan dengan benar.

Kualifikasi:
Kandidat harus memiliki latar belakang pendidikan S-1 Akuntansi atau jurusan lain yang relevan. Diperlukan pengalaman kerja minimal 1 tahun di bidang Internal Audit. Selain itu, kandidat harus teliti, memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik, dan bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas ke seluruh outlet perusahaan.

3. Mengelola arus kas perusahaan, termasuk pencatatan transaksi harian, penerimaan dan pengeluaran kas, pembayaran, serta pengelolaan petty cash.
4. Melakukan rekonsiliasi bank dan pemeriksaan transaksi keuangan untuk memastikan kesesuaian antara catatan accounting dengan transaksi aktual.
5. Mengelola Accounts Payable (AP) dan Accounts Receivable (AR), termasuk monitoring invoice, piutang, kewajiban pembayaran, serta memastikan kelengkapan dan keabsahan dokumen pendukung transaksi.
6. Melakukan perhitungan, menyiapkan, dan menyampaikan kewajiban perpajakan perusahaan, termasuk PPh, PPN, dan pajak lainnya sesuai dengan ketentuan perpajakan yang berlaku.
7. Menyiapkan data dan dokumen untuk kebutuhan pembayaran, pelaporan pajak, audit, dan pemeriksaan, serta melakukan rekonsiliasi antara data perpajakan dan pencatatan accounting.
8. Menjaga kerahasiaan, keamanan, dan kerapihan seluruh data serta dokumen accounting, finance, dan perpajakan perusahaan.
9. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen internal dan pihak eksternal, termasuk vendor, auditor, konsultan pajak, bank, dan pihak terkait lainnya dalam hal accounting, finance, dan perpajakan, serta melaksanakan tugas lain sesuai arahan atasan.

Melakukan pencatatan transaksi keuangan (cash, bank, Account Receivable (AR), dan Account Payable (AP)) secara akurat dan tepat waktu.

Menyiapkan, menyusun, dan melaporkan kewajiban perpajakan perusahaan, meliputi:
SPT Masa PPN
SPT Masa PPh Unifikasi
SPT Masa PPh Pasal 21

Mengoperasikan software akuntansi seperti Accurate dan Coretax dalam aktivitas operasional sehari-hari.
Berkoordinasi dengan tim lain untuk memastikan proses administrasi keuangan berjalan lancar.
Membantu penyusunan laporan keuangan dan kebutuhan audit apabila diperlukan.

Wajib:
Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi / Keuangan / Manajemen Perpajakan.

Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat mengenai dasar-dasar akuntansi (Jurnal, Buku Besar, AR/AP, Neraca, Laba Rugi) dan manajemen cash flow.
Memiliki pengetahuan mendalam tentang perpajakan Indonesia terkini (PPh 21, PPh Unifikasi, PPN) serta familiar dengan sistem Coretax dan e-Faktur.
Terbiasa menggunakan software Accurate dan Cortex.
Mampu mengoperasikan Internet Banking (BCA dan Mandiri).
Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel atau Google Sheets, termasuk penggunaan rumus dasar hingga menengah.
Memiliki ketelitian yang tinggi, jujur, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki kemampuan analisis angka yang baik.
Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi di dalam tim dengan komunikasi yang baik.
Domisili atau bersedia ditempatkan di Sleman, DIY.
Nilai Plus (Sangat Dipertimbangkan):
Memiliki sertifikasi Brevet Pajak A dan/atau B.
Mahir dalam mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets tingkat lanjut (fungsi VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, IF, Pivot Table) untuk kebutuhan rekonsiliasi data dalam jumlah besar.
Memahami proses audit internal maupun eksternal.
Memiliki pengalaman dalam penyusunan laporan manajemen dan analisis keuangan.
Terbiasa melakukan improvement terhadap proses administrasi keuangan.
Mahir Bahasa Inggris.
=========================================
Kriteria Kandidat yang Kami Cari:
Kami mencari seseorang yang:
Cepat, responsif, dan memiliki sense of urgency dalam bekerja.
Teliti serta memperhatikan detail dalam setiap transaksi.
Mampu menyelesaikan pekerjaan hingga tuntas tanpa perlu diawasi secara terus-menerus.
Disiplin terhadap deadline dan tidak menunda pekerjaan.
Proaktif dalam mencari solusi ketika menemukan kendala.
Komunikatif serta nyaman bekerja lintas divisi.
Memiliki integritas tinggi dalam mengelola data dan informasi keuangan perusahaan.
Nyaman bekerja dengan angka, data, dan proses administrasi yang terstruktur.

title: Corporate Auditor
description_text:
We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented and objective Corporate Auditor to support the establishment, development and evaluation of our internal control systems across financial reporting, compliance and business operations. The Corporate Auditor will be responsible for planning and conducting internal audits, assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management and internal controls, identifying areas of weakness or potential risk, and recommending practical corrective actions and improvements.

The successful candidate will bring a systematic, independent and objective approach to reviewing our processes and controls, while working collaboratively with management and stakeholders across the organization.

Kualifikasi:
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.
• 2-5 years of professional experience in internal audit, external audit, accounting or a related field.
• Good knowledge of accounting software, Microsoft Excel/spreadsheets and other relevant business systems.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong written and verbal reporting skills.
• Professional certification such as CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CPA, ACCA or equivalent is highly desirable.
• Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
• Strong understanding of internal controls, risk assessment, audit processes and financial reporting.
• Ability to remain calm and professional when working under pressure and meeting tight deadlines.
• Strong analytical and numerical skills.
• Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
• Ability to assess risks objectively and develop practical solutions.
• Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with different teams.
